Config resolution accepts inline JSON or a file path. The form is decided by the first non-whitespace character ('{' = inline, otherwise a path); NULL/blank means no config. A missing/unreadable file, a non-object JSON, or a file over 1 MB is INVALID_ARG, never silent defaults. The resolved text - not the path - is handed to the worker, so the file is read once. serve/hypercore_supervisor.py forwards config unchanged and now documents it.

The CLI takes the same rule: serve/server.py --config accepts a path or inline JSON via load_config_text/is_inline_config, and the shared-settings path is only derived when a path was actually given. serve/test_config_forms.py covers it (6 tests).
